essence: A desired, enjoyment-endowed slave-born girl should not be worshipped.
One should worship a merchant-born girl for wealth and a servant-born girl for obtaining a son.
A four-year-old girl is Kalyāṇī and a five-year-old girl is Rohiṇī.
An eight-year-old girl is Śāmbhavī and a nine-year-old girl is Durgā.
One should avoid worshipping a one-year-old and an eleven-year-old girl.
